title: Places to visit with children
titleCn: 带孩子去哪儿玩：旅游咨询处对话

paragraphs.text: Part one.
You will hear a woman asking a man in a tourist information office about places to visit in the region.
First, you have some time to look at questions one to six.
Good afternoon. Can I help you?

Yes. I'm looking for some places to visit when my sister and her children come to stay. They arrive this weekend from overseas. I'm new to the area and don't really know what to recommend. Do you have any ideas?
What about going to Alma Park to visit the zoo?
Ooh, I like the idea of that. Is it reasonably priced?
Yes, it's not a bad price. A standard adult ticket is normally 30 dollars, but there's a special deal for families of 65 dollars, which is a saving of 35 dollars.
That's a great deal. How do we get there from the city?
You can go by bus.
Is it very far?

The three eight five will get you there in approximately 40 minutes, depending on traffic. There is another bus, the 388, but it takes twenty minutes longer, so it's worth waiting a few more minutes for the more direct bus.
Okay.
Are there any special things to do there? Can you feed the animals or anything like that?
They've stopped that. But most tourists love the fact that you're allowed to hold some of the animals and get your photo taken. They just ask you to make a small payment to help with costs.
Oh, the kids would love that. My sister also likes going to the theater. Is there anything good on at the moment? She especially likes comedies.
There's a place called The Entertainment Room in Ascot. I'll just check their website.
Hmm, yes, there's a festival running at the moment with John Rosie as the main entertainer. He's really funny.
How do you spell that? Is it R-O-Z-Y?
No, it's R-O-S-I-E.
Got it. And when is it on?
Next week. It says it starts on Tuesday with a special matinee show on the Wednesday. It was supposed to finish on Friday, but because of the demand, it's been extended to Saturday.
It must be good then. Is it expensive?

paragraphs.label: I
paragraphs.text:
don't think so. Let's see. Oh, it says there's a special preview show on the Monday, and they're offering a discount on tickets that night.

00:02:16,980

We'll try and go then in that case.

00:02:19,220

Now listen and answer questions seven to ten.

00:02:23,120

paragraphs.label: I
paragraphs.text:
also wanted to spend a day in the city center. The children will get bored just looking at the shops. Is there anything else for them to do? What's the museum like?

00:02:32,540

It's very popular with children, and there's a very hands-on exhibition on at the moment. They'd love that.

00:02:38,640

Sounds good.

00:02:39,900

And there's a workshop on where they learn how to do origami.

00:02:43,620

Will they need to bring anything special for that?

00:02:46,200

On this leaflet, it says that things like scissors and all of the paper are provided. They just advise children to bring a box to carry the completed origami home in. Just a little one will do.

00:02:57,940

I'm also looking for a weekend activity. I've heard Bunyabi Island is great. Would we need a car to get around the island?

00:03:05,280

paragraphs.label: A
paragraphs.text:
four-wheel drive is a great way to explore.

00:03:08,600

You should also try snorkeling at Salty Lake.

00:03:11,440

Is that in the center of the island near the mountain?

00:03:14,200

No, it's on the ocean side.

00:03:16,220

Okay. I'll get a map and check it out. I'd like to stay there at least one night, and I quite like the idea of taking a tent and sleeping out in the open air. Are you allowed to camp there?

00:03:26,760

That would be lovely, but I'm afraid the land is owned
